annotation.title_clean: 福島復興再生特別措置法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on Special Measures for the Reconstruction and Revitalization of Fukushima
annotation.summary_en: Japanese Reconstruction Agency ministerial ordinance (2012, revised 2026) implementing the Fukushima Reconstruction and Revitalization Act. It prescribes application procedures for reconstruction plans, subsidies, business certifications, and the Fukushima Institute for Research, Education and Innovation. Robots and drones appear only as designated industrial fields; no AI governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets procedures for certifying Fukushima reconstruction and revitalization plans.
Designates fields such as drones, renewable energy and space for the special measures.
Defines business categories for new industry creation, including robots and decommissioning.
Regulates grant allocation, confirmations and designations by the Fukushima governor.
Prescribes audit and financial reporting rules for the Fukushima research institute.
